title: 1801 Prairie, the Kimball house, rebuilt in coursed Bedford stone
items: W. W. Kimball's Chateauesque house at 1801 Prairie Avenue now stands in coursed Bedford stone, with real windows, its steep slate roof, the round tower on 18th Street and the tall south pavilion, all matched to J. W. Taylor's photograph of about 1895.
The three-storey section beside the tower and the wings behind it are roofed in slate, as the photograph shows.
Still to come: the small corner turret and the rest of the east range, the pavilion's carved gable, and the corner porch and front stair.
